quests.title: Time Waits For No Man

dialogue.t: A signboard blown away by the wind... Flowers blown away by the wind... A lost cat... *sigh* It is as I expected...
Back so soon? Well then, I suppose nothing serious is happening...

dialogue.sit: No, there's still a lot of monster activity.

dialogue.t: What? There are still monsters wandering around, and in even greater numbers than before?
That's strange. Wasn't the large force that attacked Mondstadt defeated previously? Why are they still skulking about in the area?
Could they have some other plans? ...I must gather the adventurers and re-issue our commissions. We cannot take these monsters lightly.
Conducting careful investigations into the activities of monsters in the wild falls within the purview of the Adventurers' Guild. It's time to show everyone what we're made of!
Ah, yes. Please take these as thanks for you efforts.

quests.description: Mondstadt’s crisis has passed, but Cyrus seems… unhappy?
